status_sections.Summary: Unagi 21.0.2 is Red, and the single biggest risk is the open blocker SPEC-5676 on that release. Across the program there are 157 open issues, with 16 new and 14 resolved in the last 30 days for a net increase of 2; 17 blocker/critical issues remain open, and 24 versions are complete but not released.
status_sections.Risks & slips:
- SPEC-5676 is the open blocker on Unagi 21.0.2; the release is Red with 1 open issue out of 5 in scope.
- SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, and SPEC-5719 are open blockers with no assignee.
- SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, and SPEC-5561 are long-open blockers and are on the escalation list.
- SPEC-5375 is the open critical issue and is also escalated.
- Hygiene remains weak: 151 issues have no fix version, 98 have no component, 51 have no assignee, and 139 are stale.
status_sections.Asks / decisions needed:
- Assign owners to SPEC-5625, SPEC-5700, SPEC-5701, SPEC-5705, SPEC-5713, and SPEC-5719.
- Confirm the priority and recovery plan for SPEC-5676 so Unagi 21.0.2 can move off Red.
- Review the escalation list for SPEC-4693, SPEC-4963, SPEC-5487, SPEC-5444, SPEC-5468, SPEC-5483, SPEC-5561, and SPEC-5375 and decide which items need immediate management attention.
- Decide whether the 24 versions complete but not released should be released or held.
status_sections.Next steps:
- Triage the 17 open blocker/critical issues and update status in the next program review.
- Clean up issue hygiene for no fix version, no component, no assignee, and stale issues.
- Reconfirm release readiness for Unagi 21.0.2 and Vimba 22.0.0.
- Track progress on the 16 new issues opened in the last 30 days against the 14 resolved.
